title: Peppermint Bizmoto, VITRO Inc. ink MPLS deal to boost payment infra

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Peppermint Bizmoto Inc., a Philippine electronic money issuer (EMI), is strengthening its digital payment infrastructure through a dedicated Multiprotocol Label Switching (MPLS) connectivity agreement involving VITRO Inc., part of the PLDT Group’s enterprise technology ecosystem. The initiative marks an important milestone in Peppermint’s commitment to building secure, reliable, and scalable payment infrastructure to support its growing network of merchants, financial institutions, and technology partners. Leveraging VITRO’s enterprise infrastructure Vitro Inc., the ICT subsidiary of the PLDT Group, is a leading provider of enterprise data center and cloud on-ramp solutions in the Philippines.
